headline: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Seeks $5.5 Billion Talc Lawsuit Settlement
summary: Johnson & Johnson proposed a $5.5b settlement to resolve tens of thousands of ovarian cancer talc lawsuits. The offer aims to address a decade-long legal dispute involving the company’s talcum powder products. The settlement would require approval from a majority of claimants before it can move forward.
